title: The four tabs All, Work Orders, Estimates, Completed work in every display
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user · 1 browser · about 15 minutes.
  • Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043, v26.40.8-7a95011).
  • [User-A] = you: an Owner/Admin user (on a QA branch the Admin quick-login user, shown as "Admin ShopView"). The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit.
  • Desktop browser with the window at least 1024 pixels wide (full screen on an ordinary laptop or monitor). Below that width the page shows only List.
  • One location for the whole case, shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); everything below is created in this location.
  • [Tech-A]: one eligible technician at this location. A person only counts as a technician here when the staff member is active (not deactivated), Time Clock is on, the Role is neither Office User nor Time Clock User, and this location is picked in their Location field.
  • Customer "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Tabs" (used by this case only) with three work orders, all led by [Tech-A]: [WO-1] in Estimate, [WO-2] in Approved, [WO-3] in Complete.
  • Names and numbers are examples; what must hold: one work order in each of Estimate, Approved and Complete, all led by the same technician.

Setup

  1. Sign in as an Owner/Admin user (on a QA branch: the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView"). The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit (to check: your initials at the top right > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > Work orders).
  2. Check the location in the top bar next to the bell; to change it click your initials at the top right > Change Location. Create everything below in this location.
  3. Settings (your initials at the top right > Settings) > Staff: reuse a technician only after checking it is active, has Time Clock on, a Role other than Office User or Time Clock User and this location in Location; otherwise add one: New Staff Member > First Name and Last Name, an Email, Role "Technician", at least one Department (required), Location = this location, Time Clock on > Save & Close. Record them as [Tech-A] (e.g. Esther Howard).
  4. Create the customer used only by this case: top menu Customers > New Customer > Name "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Tabs" > Save. On the customer page click the Contacts tab > New Contact > First Name and Last Name > Save (a new asset needs a contact). Then click the Assets tab > New Asset > pick the Contact, then Year, Make, Model and Unit (e.g. 2022, Freightliner, M2, unit "TRK-118") > Save. Make is required; Unit can be left empty.
  5. Create three work orders for "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Tabs": Work Orders > Create Work Order > in the New Work Order window pick the Customer and its Asset > Save. The new work order opens with the New Line form (otherwise click New Line on the Lines tab): in "What Are You Doing?" pick a ready-made line (e.g. "Replace - Brake pot"; typed free text finds no results) and click Save & Close. Write down the number the build gives each work order (on a QA branch they look like "S10043-17581"). Put three of your work orders in different statuses (open each one and change its status with the status control on the work order page):
    • [WO-1] (the expected results call it "S1-352"): left in Estimate (do not turn on Line Approved). Its Lead technician is read-only on the work order page while it is an Estimate, so give it its lead from Board View: the card's More actions (…) > Reassign lead technician > pick [Tech-A] > Reassign.
    • [WO-2] (the expected results call it "S1-702"): moved to Approved (turn on Line Approved in the New Line form before saving, or use the line's approve control on the Lines tab), then Lead Technician dropdown = [Tech-A] (it saves at once).
    • [WO-3] (the expected results call it "S1-689"): approved and given Lead Technician [Tech-A] the same way, then moved to Complete with the status control on the work order page.
  6. Check the setup worked: Work Orders > All tab > Search "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Tabs" shows exactly [WO-1] (Estimate), [WO-2] (Approved) and [WO-3] (Complete), each with lead [Tech-A]. If a status or lead is wrong, fix it on the work order page (or from Board View for the Estimate) before starting.
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders and stay in List.
  2. Click each tab in turn: All, Work Orders, Estimates, Completed. For each tab write down which of your three work orders ([WO-1], [WO-2], [WO-3]) appear.
  3. In the display switcher at the right of the toolbar, click Tech View (tooltip "Tech View").
  4. Click each tab in turn again and write down which of your three work orders appear under [Tech-A].
  5. In the display switcher at the right of the toolbar, click Board View (tooltip "Board View").
  6. Click each tab in turn again and write down which of your three work orders appear in [Tech-A]'s column.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • All four tabs (All, Work Orders, Estimates, Completed) are shown in every display.
  • Each tab shows the same work orders in List, Tech View and Board View. With the example data: All shows 3 (S1-352, S1-702, S1-689), Work Orders shows S1-702, Estimates shows S1-352, Completed shows S1-689.
  • This case does not check which tab opens first: the default tab was taken out of scope and stays as production has it today.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10044 (Story 1, Switch between display options); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), Feature Overview, Key Decisions, read 8 Oct 2026. PO decision Chris Ward, PRD footer comment 25 Sep 2026 ("The default-tab change is out too"). Review Decisions 853901313 DR-33.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • Feature Overview: “The existing filter views (the tabs on the left — All, Work Orders, Estimates, Completed) and the filter bar (search, status, assigned to me, and so on) apply the same way in every display option.”
  • Key Decisions: “Permissions. Work Orders view permits viewing all four filter tabs and reordering technician groups/columns.”

Last checked against build v26.40.8-7a95011 on 10/8/2026.
